digest.component_or_area: Store write seam and event validation
propositions: The store accepts event bodies containing live credentials (Anthropic, GitHub PAT, Gemini, Jira, OpenAI, PyPI keys) with no write-time content screening, causing a single comment to wedge the shared tickets branch for all concurrent agents when GitHub push protection rejects the ref.

The write seam is not `append_event` alone; inbound Jira reconcile calls finalize_event halves directly, bypassing append_event, so a screen at append_event would leave external untrusted input (Jira comments) unprotected.

On detecting a credential pattern in event data at `_seam.finalize_event`, the write is REFUSED and the event does not land, with a `--allow-secret-pattern=<reason>` override available for operator judgment; refusal must name the matched family and field+line without echoing the secret value.

Secret detection patterns are tuned by measurement against the live store rather than by argument; fixed-width matching windows prevent padding from diluting entropy, and line-anchoring prevents prose enumerating patterns from firing.
The reconciler's inbound translate and all other write paths must route through `_seam.finalize_event` to enforce the screen uniformly, and the override is CLI-only with no MCP exposure.

Benign look-alikes (truncated placeholders like `sk-ant-api03-...`, regex literals, prose enumerating banners) remain writable so the screen is safe to leave on by default; measured false-positive rate on the live store is one (AWS doc example).
